branches.why: no numeric or year identifier for the CITED work. The only numbers in the citing document are '25-03' (x2) and '2025', which identify fcsm-25-03 itself, not the framework it cites.

the span cites 'the Framework for Data Quality' by bare title with no number, year, or qualifier, and describes its PURPOSE — 'to help analysts and the public assess fitness for use of data sets' — which is the framework itself. Corroborating negative evidence: the string 'case stud' does not occur anywhere in the citing document, so the case-studies companion (fcsm-23-02) is excluded on its own distinguishing feature.
